about: Ambiguity classes: text in a note that could be read two ways, where the wrong reading could let data out. A note that matches a class is an error (conformance L2-AMBIGUITY): it is read as `read_as` says, and every export refuses until a person fixes it. Near-misses (a class whose `kind` is `lookalike`) are listed because they are what a person writes by mistake; everything else outside the grammar (`kind`: `grammar`) is an error too, whatever it looks like. A new class is added in a kernel release, with its fixture. Only an owner's decision entry removes a class or widens a grammar, again with a fixture.

classes.looks_like: The note seems to start with frontmatter, but the first line is not exactly `---` (a blank line, a byte-order mark or other text before it), or no later line is exactly `---` to close it.
classes.fix: Make the first line of the file exactly `---`, and close the frontmatter with a line that is exactly `---`.

classes.looks_like: The frontmatter is not in the YAML subset of CONVENTIONS "Instance config": a quote that is never closed, a key written twice, a tab in the indentation, indentation that fits no key, an anchor, a tag, a multi-line string, or a value that is a placeholder such as `{{YYYY-MM-DD}}`, left unfilled.
classes.fix: Rewrite the line the message names as a plain `key: value` line; write each key once.

classes.looks_like: A key that looks like `visibility` but is not exactly it at the top level: other capitals (`Visibility`), a near spelling (`visiblity`), or `visibility` nested under another key.
classes.fix: Write `visibility:` once, in lower case, at the start of its own line in the frontmatter, and remove the lookalike.

classes.looks_like: `visibility` has a value other than exactly `private`, `internal` or `public`: other capitals (`Public`), extra characters, a list.
classes.fix: Use exactly one of `private`, `internal`, `public`, in lower case.

classes.looks_like: `<!-- 🔒 private -->` opens while another private block is still open.
classes.read_as: the note cannot be stripped: export refuses
classes.fix: Close each private block with `<!-- /🔒 -->` before opening the next one; blocks do not nest.

classes.looks_like: `<!-- /🔒 -->` with no block open, or `<!-- 🔒 private -->` never closed — even when the two markers occur equally often.
classes.read_as: the note cannot be stripped: export refuses
classes.fix: Put exactly one `<!-- /🔒 -->` after each `<!-- 🔒 private -->`, and none anywhere else.

classes.looks_like: An HTML comment that looks like a private-block marker but is not exactly one: a lock sign, or the word `private` at its start, with other spacing, capitals or wording (`<!--🔒 private-->`, `<!-- private -->`, `<!-- 🔒 Private -->`), or a marker whose closing `-->` is missing or mistyped (`<!-- 🔒 private --`).
classes.read_as: the note cannot be stripped: export refuses
classes.fix: Write the markers exactly as `<!-- 🔒 private -->` and `<!-- /🔒 -->`, or remove the comment.
